query:
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO file_measurements (
                ingest_id,
                data_source_id,
                rel_path,
                device,
                inode,
                size,
                mtime,
                ctime,
                hardlink_count,
                is_symlink,
                media_measurement_id,
                nfo_text
            ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            RETURNING id AS "id!: _"
